Title: New planned datacenter region in China (China North 3)

Body.Content:
Customers and partners in China will benefit from cloud services. Availability Zones in the new China North 3 region will provide customers with high availability and additional tolerance to datacenter failures. The new datacenter region will have a presence in Hebei province, in response to growing customer demand, supporting the creation of new jobs and local business growth.

Learn more.
